_ball_radius: A ball's RADIUS in millimetres, and it has to match the set actually on the table: American balls are 2.25 in (28.6 radius), English are 2 in (25.4). The detector does not measure - it reads each ball's colour from a patch this size - so a wrong value quietly makes the scoring worse without anything looking broken. `poolarena doctor` measures the balls and says if it disagrees.
_comment: Playing surface inside the cushions, in millimetres. Measure your own table: nominal sizes vary by manufacturer. Sizes known by name: 7ft 8ft 8ft-pro 9ft 10ft snooker.
_ball_set: american = numbered 1-15. english = reds and yellows (UK blackball), which has no numbers, so 9-ball and cut-throat are unavailable and everything else plays the same.
_cloth: Your cloth colour as hex. The projector multiplies its light by what the cloth reflects, so the palette is chosen from this. Pale blue: #8FB7D9. Powder blue: #6E9BC5. Tournament green: #1B6E54. Also settable with --cloth.
